purpose: Native byte-BPE / neural teacher-forced pipeline smoke fixture only
provenance: Repository-authored short Turkish sentences; not scraped, not a benchmark, and not a language-quality dataset.
record_framing: UTF-8 text; one line is one bounded training record; terminal LF is framing and is not passed to the current line adapter.
quality_boundary: A successful run validates codec/trainer/checkpoint/generation plumbing. It does not establish Turkish fluency, factuality, safety, instruction following, or generalization.
